cv.name: Ravi Lachman
cv.headline: Electrical Engineer | LV/MV Design, Shore Power & Process Installations
cv.summary: Electrical engineer with seven years across switchgear design, field service and E&I projects in the Rotterdam port and process industry. Moved between design office, site and contract roles on purpose, and now leads the electrical scope of shore-power projects for port terminals.

experience.title: Electrical Engineer
bullets: Lead electrical design for shore-power connections (6.6 kV / 11 kV) at two container and ferry terminals
Load-flow and short-circuit studies in ETAP; selectivity reviews with the grid operator
Prepared single-line diagrams and cable calculations according to NEN 1010 and IEC 61936
Commissioned the first berth connection three weeks ahead of the vessel trial date

experience.title: Project Engineer E&I (contract)
bullets: Electrical and instrumentation scope for a tank-terminal expansion in an ATEX zone
Reviewed vendor documentation and FAT reports for MCC panels

experience.title: Field Service Engineer
bullets: Fault-finding and retrofits of variable-speed drives on dredging and offshore vessels

experience.title: Junior Electrical Designer
bullets: Designed LV distribution boards in EPLAN Electric P8 to IEC 61439
Cut drawing revision rounds from four to two by introducing standard macros

education.details: Graduation project: harmonic filtering for port cranes

skills: ETAP, EPLAN Electric P8, AutoCAD Electrical
